newsitem.title: FINLAND: P&G orders Valmet tissue machine.
newsitem.headline: P&G orders Valmet tissue machine.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Thursday it won an order to deliver a new tissue paper machine to Procter & Gamble Co (P&G) of the United States.
"Valmet has received an order for a complete tissue machine and auxiliary equipment for the Procter and Gamble Company's announced expansion at its Albany mill in Georgia, USA," Valmet said.
It did not give the value of the deal, but said it was part of P&G's expansion investment worth $180 million.
The investment will raise P&G's annual output of tissue, towel and facial products by 65,000 tonnes a year, Valmet said.

The new tissue machine -- to be one of the biggest of its kind in the world -- will be the second delivered by Valmet for P&G's Albany mill. The first one ordered by P&G two years ago was due for start-up shortly, Valmet added.
P&G is among the world's largest makers of tissue paper products, Valmet addded.
